title: Selling Plans Rate Card — Monthly Listing Allowance and Insertion Fees
content:
Each **Selling Plans** tier includes a number of listings per calendar month that carry no insertion fee. Listings beyond that allowance are charged the plan's insertion fee after allowance. A fixed-price listing runs for a set number of days and then renews automatically; every renewal counts as a new listing against the allowance of the month it renews in.

| Plan | Listings per calendar month with no insertion fee | Insertion fee per listing beyond the allowance | Days a fixed-price listing runs before it renews |
|---|---|---|---|
| Individual Seller Plan | 250 | USD 0.35 | 30 |
| Starter Store | 1000 | USD 0.30 | 30 |
| Basic Store | 1000 | USD 0.25 | 30 |
| Premium Store | 10000 | USD 0.10 | 30 |
| Anchor Store | 25000 | USD 0.05 | 30 |
| Enterprise Store | 100000 | USD 0.05 | 30 |

## Reading the rate card

**Do renewals use up the allowance?** Yes. A listing that renews automatically after its 30 days is counted again, as a new listing, in the calendar month in which it renews.

**Which tiers share an insertion fee?** The Anchor Store and the Enterprise Store both charge USD 0.05 per listing beyond the allowance; their allowances differ (25000 and 100000 listings a month).

**Which tiers share an allowance?** The Starter Store and the Basic Store both include 1000 listings a month; beyond the allowance the Starter Store charges USD 0.30 and the Basic Store USD 0.25 per listing.
